name: Banco Patagonia S.A.
summary: Banco Patagonia S.A. provides various banking products and services in Argentina. It offers savings, retired, salary, current, agro, and minor accounts; accounts for SMEs; and foreign trade services. The company also provides Patagonia leasing, capital marketing, and alternative financing services. In addition, it offers loans; safe deposit boxes; credit and debit cards; and home, car, motorbike, mobility, ATM robbery, protected belongings, smartphone, pets, personal accidents, life, health, burial, and rental bond insurance products. Further, the company offers financial agency services; mobile banking services; business cards; investments for fixed-term, mutual funds, and financial trusts;…
